description: This file defines the class 'SugarWidgetSubPanelEditRoleButton', a widget for rendering an edit button within a subpanel in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for displaying header cells and list entries, generating links for editing roles related to contacts and opportunities.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelEditRoleButton
classes.description: A widget class that renders an edit role button in subpanels, extending SugarWidgetField with methods for display header and list cells.

methods.name: displayHeaderCell
methods.description: Returns a non-breaking space to render an empty header cell in the subpanel.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates an HTML link for editing a record's role, based on the provided layout definition.
